description: Search the parfum1 catalogue by words in the perfume name, house or scent family (all words must match, accents ignored), optionally within one house. Returns a page of perfumes in popularity order with the starting price, stock, rating and product URL.

house.description: Only perfumes of this house: a house handle or name from list_houses, for example "nishane".

query.description: Words to find in the perfume name, house or scent family, for example "oud" or "nishane hacivat". Leave empty to list the catalogue.

name: search_perfumes
title: Search perfumes
